decision: Every answer has a replayable trace: query → retrieve → rerank → generate → judge
why: When an answer is wrong you need to know which stage failed.
value: Failures are attributed to retrieval, generation or judging.

decision: Model releases pass an eval gate on faithfulness and citation accuracy
why: A cheaper, faster model is only better if it stays grounded.
alternative: Ship on latency and cost alone.
value: Releases are blocked automatically when grounding regresses.

decision: Fine-tuned models ship behind canary routing with an adjustable split
why: Offline evals miss real-traffic edge cases.
value: Regressions reach a fraction of users and roll back in one change.

decision: Show the top five retrieved chunks with scores and sources
why: Most bad answers are bad retrieval; seeing the chunks makes that obvious.
value: Retrieval quality is debugged before prompts are blamed.

decision: Failing scenarios become a review queue, not a number
why: A 92% pass rate hides the three failures that matter.
value: Each failure gets an owner and becomes a regression test.
